linter_requires: {tool} runs only where its configuration exists, and none was found at the workspace root ({files}): it does not apply here.
linter_no_files: No file {tool} checks was found in the workspace: it does not apply here.
linter_missing: {tool} is not in the JGates tools image ({detail}). Download the tools of this JGates version (jgates setup); JGates never installs a tool on your machine.
linter_condition_read_only: Read-only: the tool reports what it finds and rewrites nothing.
linter_no_invocation: The plan has no invocation for the instance {tool}.
linter_cancelled: The run was cancelled; {tool} was stopped and its partial output was kept in the logs.
linter_timeout: {tool} exceeded the limit of {seconds} s and was ended.
linter_exit_error: {tool} ended with code {code} without a result JGates can read: {detail}
linter_each_file_loop: the loop over the files did not finish
linter_each_file_markers: the output of the loop over the files does not name every file
